race.comment: BILK (2) is a three start maiden who has placed twice. Resumed from a break here on heavy ground and wound up strongly for third. Will strip fitter and has further upside. Close to a win and gets chance. KIAKAMI (13) is a filly by So You Think making her first appearance. Was runner-up in a jump-out at Murray Bridge on August 13. Senior rider aboard off the inside and expected to measure up. TIKKAMOS (6) showed ability in two runs in first campaign and has trialled nicely leading into this. One to watch closely for a push. THE MUSCLE (5) was runner-up in heavy going down at Mount Gambier last time and shapes as one of the top chances.
